# Gura (גורה)

> A home for movement, martial arts, and improvisation, taught by Guy Gurevich. Gura dojo in Montefiore, Tel Aviv. בית לתנועה, לחימה ואילתור בהדרכת גיא גורביץ׳. דוג׳ו גורה בשכונת מונטיפיורי, תל אביב.

Gura is a dojo in Tel Aviv. The site has two pages, one in Hebrew and one in English, with the same content.

## Pages
- [Hebrew page](https://guradojo.com/): the full site in Hebrew
- [English page](https://guradojo.com/en/): the full site in English
- [Full text for AI assistants](https://guradojo.com/llms-full.txt): the copy of both pages as plain text

## Facts
- Teacher: Guy Gurevich (גיא גורביץ׳), a former Olympic judoka.
- Place: Montefiore neighborhood, Tel Aviv. Our dojo is in the heart of Tel Aviv, in the Montefiore neighborhood.
- The class: a gradual process in five stages, from listening inward, through movement and physical work, to meeting another person; it closes with returning to observation.
- Safety: "A safe and supportive frame". The work is adapted to each person's abilities, experience, and physical condition.
- Contact: WhatsApp +972523112310, email gurevichguy@gmail.com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/guygurevitch_90

## Not published on the site
- Schedule, price, and street address are not on the page. Ask Guy on WhatsApp.
